Read the held original (7 FR 3277) in full: Executive Order 9155 of May 1, 1942, signed Franklin D. Roosevelt, approving Civil Service Commission regulations on efficiency-rating boards of review (items 1-7; item 7 supersedes the EO 8748 regulations and makes these effective July 1, 1942). The text preceding it on the page ("This order shall be effective as of January 24, 1942") belongs to EO 9154 and is not part of this order. The President's approval is a one-time act; every continuing rule is in the approved regulations. Basis ACT:EO:9155>EO:9252@3912709b3385f47b: the held FR text of EO 9252 of October 9, 1942 (7 FR 8079), signed by Roosevelt, item 8, reads that "These regulations supersede the regulations in Executive Order No. -8748 ... and in Executive Order No. 9155 of May 1, 1942, and shall be effective immediately", with a retroactive exception (to July 1, 1941) limited to EO 9252's own successor-service provision, which does not preserve any EO 9155 rule. That supersedes the whole operative content on 1942-10-09, after EO 9155's July 1, 1942 effective date, so no earlier end applies. The TERM records are one-year member terms and a ninety-day appeal window, internal conditions that yield no end. The single OFR observation ("Superseded by: EO 9252, October 9, 1942") agrees; no history flags. Cruden's 6 hits are EO 9252 (FR and APP copies, and the EO 9253 file that shares the page), the EO 9154 page and the order itself; no revival. Status no is supported.
